summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with hypoxia and hypotension due to severe pneumonia and sepsis. She was treated with intravenous vancomycin and piperacillin-tazobactam, required vasopressor support initially, and showed gradual improvement in oxygenation and mental status. Delirium developed in the ICU and was managed by medication optimization. Repeat imaging showed slight improvement in bilateral pneumonia, and she completed a 7-day antibiotic course. Her chronic conditions, including paraplegia, chronic pain, and hypothyroidism, were managed throughout. She was discharged home on 2L oxygen with stable vital signs and instructions for ongoing chest therapy and medication adherence.
